Morgan: FYI PR #9542 is blocked on CI — the windows-gpu-e2e job keeps failing on `kv_cache_eviction.test_shard_recovery`. Can someone take a quick look?
Alice: On it, pinged my WIP Windows VM.
CI Bot: buildkite: windows-gpu-e2e failed — step `smoke/gpu/e2e` (link: https://ci.example.com/builds/3456)
Ben: I saw that flake last month, usually timing-related around eviction/async flush. Do we have the failing log?
Morgan: pasted below — failing assertion is flaky: expected shard to recover within 200ms but sometimes takes ~350ms
Morgan: ```
AssertionError: shard not recovered
  at kv_cache_eviction.test_shard_recovery (tests/kv_cache/test_eviction.py:48)
  Last events:
    eviction triggered at t=0.123
    flush scheduled at t=0.128
    recovery observed at t=0.478
```
Alice: I can repro locally with `pytest tests/kv_cache/test_eviction.py::test_shard_recovery -k windows -rA --maxfail=1` with --repeat 50 it fails ~1/8 runs.
Ben: Ugh that's noisy. I want to avoid arbitrary sleeps in production code. Two options: 1) bump the test timeout to 500ms (test-only change) or 2) add a test hook to wait for explicit condition instead of fixed sleep. Option 2 is better but slower to ship.
Morgan: We need unblock for a tenant-facing fix. I'm proposing a temporary test-only increase to 500ms and add a TODO to follow up with a proper fix. I can open a tiny follow-up PR to revert later.
Alice: Sounds reasonable for the short term. Can you push the test update and trigger CI?
Morgan: pushed commit 3a7f2b4 with timeout bump, re-running CI. @Ben can you review when you have a sec?
Ben: Looking now. Quick scan LGTM but leaving one nit about the comment (see inline).
Alice: rerun started by Morgan — job 3457 queued
CI Bot: buildkite: windows-gpu-e2e passed on rerun (build 3457) :white_check_mark:
Morgan: Thanks all. Ben — can you approve the PR so I can merge? This is blocking a customer rollback.
Ben: Approved, merging after final smoke. :thumbsup:
Alice: If it flakes again we'll open a ticket to implement the explicit condition and add an env var to speed tests in CI.
Morgan: merging now. Will follow up with the cleanup PR.
CI Bot: github: PR #9542 merged by Morgan (commit 3a7f2b4)
Morgan: ":tada: thanks team"
